items.front: Greatest Indo-Greek king and his capital?
items.back: Menander I 'Soter'; capital Sakala (Sialkot).
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: Text recording Menander's dialogue with a monk?
items.back: Milinda Panho ('Questions of Milinda'), with monk Nagasena.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: Who set up the Heliodorus pillar, for whom, and to which deity?
items.back: Envoy Heliodorus of Antialcidas, to king Bhagabhadra, dedicated to Vasudeva.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: Where is the Heliodorus (Garuda-dhvaja) pillar?
items.back: Besnagar / Vidisha (c. 113 BCE) — early evidence of Bhagavatism.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: First Indo-Greek to invade India?
items.back: Demetrius I (son of Euthydemus, c. 180 BCE).
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: What coinage 'firsts' do the Indo-Greeks hold in India?
items.back: First bilingual (Greek + Kharosthi) portrait coins; first gold coins.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: From where did the Indo-Greeks break away?
items.back: Bactria's secession from the Seleucid empire (Diodotus).
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: What does Ashoka's Rock Edict 13 mention about Greeks?
items.back: Names five Yona/Yavana kings (Antiochus, Ptolemy, etc.).
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: Seleucus–Chandragupta treaty (305 BCE) outcome?
items.back: NW territories ceded to Chandragupta; Megasthenes sent as envoy.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: Art school linked to Indo-Greek/Kushana influence?
items.back: Gandhara school (Greco-Roman Buddha images, grey schist).
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: Which religion did Menander patronise?
items.back: Buddhism; his coins bear the Dharmachakra (wheel).
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: Last Indo-Greek ruler; who displaced them?
items.back: Strato II; displaced by Shakas/Yuezhi and later Kushanas.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History

items.front: After Alexander’s death, how far did Seleucus Nicator’s rule extend?
items.back: From Turkey to the Indus river.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History: Indo-Greek Invasion.txt; NCERT/R.S. Sharma (Central Asian Contacts) standard treatment; Indo-Greek PYQ bank (.research/pyq-bank/hist-ancient-indo-greek.md)

items.front: Which foreign systems are believed to have influenced Mauryan administrative institutions?
items.back: Persian and Greek systems.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History: Indo-Greek Invasion.txt; NCERT/R.S. Sharma (Central Asian Contacts) standard treatment; Indo-Greek PYQ bank (.research/pyq-bank/hist-ancient-indo-greek.md)

items.front: Which Indo-Greek king extended Bactrian rule south of the Hindu Kush?
items.back: Demetrius II.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History: Indo-Greek Invasion.txt; NCERT/R.S. Sharma (Central Asian Contacts) standard treatment; Indo-Greek PYQ bank (.research/pyq-bank/hist-ancient-indo-greek.md)

items.front: What was the extent of Menander I’s kingdom?
items.back: From the Kabul valley to western Uttar Pradesh, including the Swat valley and Punjab.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History: Indo-Greek Invasion.txt; NCERT/R.S. Sharma (Central Asian Contacts) standard treatment; Indo-Greek PYQ bank (.research/pyq-bank/hist-ancient-indo-greek.md)

items.front: Milinda is the name of which Indo-Greek king, and in what language is the Milinda Panho?
items.back: Menander I; the Milinda Panho is a Pali Buddhist text.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History: Indo-Greek Invasion.txt; NCERT/R.S. Sharma (Central Asian Contacts) standard treatment; Indo-Greek PYQ bank (.research/pyq-bank/hist-ancient-indo-greek.md)

items.front: Which Buddhist symbols appear on Menander’s coins?
items.back: The Lotus and the Wheel (Dharmachakra), alongside Greek deities.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History: Indo-Greek Invasion.txt; NCERT/R.S. Sharma (Central Asian Contacts) standard treatment; Indo-Greek PYQ bank (.research/pyq-bank/hist-ancient-indo-greek.md)

items.front: Approximate reign of Menander I?
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History: Indo-Greek Invasion.txt; NCERT/R.S. Sharma (Central Asian Contacts) standard treatment; Indo-Greek PYQ bank (.research/pyq-bank/hist-ancient-indo-greek.md)

items.front: Whose son was Heliodorus, and from which city did he come?
items.back: Son of Dion, a Greek from Taxila.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History: Indo-Greek Invasion.txt; NCERT/R.S. Sharma (Central Asian Contacts) standard treatment; Indo-Greek PYQ bank (.research/pyq-bank/hist-ancient-indo-greek.md)

items.front: For what were the Indo-Greek gold coins used?
items.back: For larger transactions.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History: Indo-Greek Invasion.txt; NCERT/R.S. Sharma (Central Asian Contacts) standard treatment; Indo-Greek PYQ bank (.research/pyq-bank/hist-ancient-indo-greek.md)

items.front: Remains of which three cities show Hellenistic–Indian fusion under the Indo-Greeks?
items.back: Sakala, Ai-Khanoum and Taxila.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History: Indo-Greek Invasion.txt; NCERT/R.S. Sharma (Central Asian Contacts) standard treatment; Indo-Greek PYQ bank (.research/pyq-bank/hist-ancient-indo-greek.md)

items.front: Which two religious traditions did Indo-Greek rule help develop?
items.back: Mahayana Buddhism and the Bhakti traditions.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History: Indo-Greek Invasion.txt; NCERT/R.S. Sharma (Central Asian Contacts) standard treatment; Indo-Greek PYQ bank (.research/pyq-bank/hist-ancient-indo-greek.md)

items.front: How did Indo-Greek rule affect Greek merchants?
items.back: Greek merchants became affluent through the trade routes they controlled.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History: Indo-Greek Invasion.txt; NCERT/R.S. Sharma (Central Asian Contacts) standard treatment; Indo-Greek PYQ bank (.research/pyq-bank/hist-ancient-indo-greek.md)

items.front: Until when did the last Indo-Greek ruler, Strato II, rule?
items.back: Until 55 BCE (some sources say 10 AD).

items.front: Besides invasions, what weakened the Indo-Greek kingdom?
items.back: Internal power struggles and the decline of trade routes.

items.front: Which Sanskrit stage word shows Greek influence on Indian drama?
items.back: Yavanika, the curtain.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History: Indo-Greek Invasion.txt; NCERT/R.S. Sharma (Central Asian Contacts) standard treatment; Indo-Greek PYQ bank (.research/pyq-bank/hist-ancient-indo-greek.md)

items.front: From which word does the Indian name Yavana for the Greeks come?
items.back: From Ionian, the Greeks of western Asia Minor.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History: Indo-Greek Invasion.txt; NCERT/R.S. Sharma (Central Asian Contacts) standard treatment; Indo-Greek PYQ bank (.research/pyq-bank/hist-ancient-indo-greek.md)

items.front: What did Chandragupta give Seleucus Nicator under the 305 BCE treaty?
items.back: 500 elephants.
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History: Indo-Greek Invasion.txt; NCERT/R.S. Sharma (Central Asian Contacts) standard treatment; Indo-Greek PYQ bank (.research/pyq-bank/hist-ancient-indo-greek.md)

items.front: Which provinces did Seleucus cede to Chandragupta in 305 BCE?
items.back: Arachosia (Kandahar), Gedrosia, Paropamisadae (Kabul) and Aria (Herat).
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History: Indo-Greek Invasion.txt; NCERT/R.S. Sharma (Central Asian Contacts) standard treatment; Indo-Greek PYQ bank (.research/pyq-bank/hist-ancient-indo-greek.md)

items.front: Which text says the Yavanas reached Pataliputra?
items.back: The Gargi Samhita (its Yuga Purana section).
items.source: APPSC GK — Ancient History: Indo-Greek Invasion.txt; NCERT/R.S. Sharma (Central Asian Contacts) standard treatment; Indo-Greek PYQ bank (.research/pyq-bank/hist-ancient-indo-greek.md)

items.front: Which city at Taxila was built by the Indo-Greeks?
items.back: Sirkap.
